entities.name: Thrasios
entities.description: Legendary triton wizard and warrior of Meletis on Theros.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea, whose sanction Thrasios believes he has.

entities.name: Olantin
entities.description: Fabled polis Thrasios claims to have visited.

events.summary: Meletians save Thrasios's family from marauding minotaurs, so he fights for Meletis.
events.quote: Meletians saved Thrasios's family from a pack of marauding minotaurs

events.summary: Believing he has Thassa's sanction, Thrasios leaves on a pilgrimage to the ocean's depths.
events.quote: has embarked on a pilgrimage to the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

relations.note: Believes he has her divine sanction.
relations.quote: He believes he possesses the divine sanction of Thassa
